class.jaymoskingdoms.cleric.desc: A priest sworn to a patron god at once. Raise the holy symbol and the dead before you crumble or run, as many times a day as your god allows (a short rest brings the turnings back). Tap it to pray: healing prayers, sanctuary, restoration. The class key blesses everyone near you. A village priest will teach you the symbol's making. Pick your patron.
class.jaymoskingdoms.druid.desc: Nature's rites with a druid's sprig: plant growth, moonbeam and the speech of beasts, and a world that answers. Study a wolf, a bear, a hawk or a fish for a while, and the class key wraps you in its shape for some minutes. A beast casts nothing and cannot hold gear. A farmer or a shepherd will teach you the sprig.
class.jaymoskingdoms.monk.desc: Bare hands, or a boxer's gear, hit like a weapon while you wear no plate, and you are taught the first of the boxing styles. Time the class key as an arrow comes and you catch it, the real arrow; sneak and the key throws it back. With none coming, the key readies a stunning blow that costs a ki (back after a short rest); a boss shrugs it off until its resistances are spent. Falling beside a wall, you slow yourself.
class.jaymoskingdoms.paladin.desc: Sworn to an oath: mercy, justice or honour. Smite from a daily pool (sneak and the class key readies one), lay on hands from a daily pool (the class key), and your presence steadies friends and shrugs off fear. Plate weighs half as much on you. Break your oath by its acts and every gift is withheld until you atone, at a shrine or with a priest. Pick your oath.
class.jaymoskingdoms.ranger.desc: The Archer and the Survivalist in one. Arrows and bolts hit 35% harder, half again at the head, with all the pinning to the ground and the wall; you jump with a bow drawn and land soft; hunger drains slower, falls hurt less, a heart more, and you mend on your own. A favoured foe takes a quarter more from you, more again on favoured land; there you walk quietly. The class key reads the ground for tracks; sneak and the key claims the country you stand in. Pick your foe.
class.jaymoskingdoms.warlock.desc: A pact with a patron god buys you magic in pact slots, not mana: a pact seal in the hand casts hard, and a short rest brings the slots back. But the patron wants paying: every few casts a debt is called, in favour, an errand, blood or coin, and a debt left to fall due is collected. Pick your patron.
class.jaymoskingdoms.tinkerer.desc: At a tinkering station, sneak and use your gear to put a small enchantment on it: a returning trident, springing boots, a glowing shield. The smiths of a village teach you to make some of the gadgets that others only find in old chests.

class.jaymoskingdoms.option.mercy.desc: No blow for the helpless: the held, the fleeing, the downed, folk and pets. Kill one and the oath breaks.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.justice.desc: No crime of your own. Any theft, arson or murder breaks the oath.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.honour.desc: A fair fight. A blow on what has not noticed you, or a theft, breaks the oath.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.undead.desc: Your favoured foe: Zombies, skeletons and all the walking dead.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.raiders.desc: Your favoured foe: Illagers, witches and their beasts.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.beasts.desc: Your favoured foe: Wolves, bears, boars and other wild things that bite.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.spiders.desc: Your favoured foe: Spiders, silverfish and the crawling kind.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.greenskins.d: Your favoured foe: Goblins, orcs, ogres and trolls, and the piglin kin.
class.jaymoskingdoms.option.monsters.des: Your favoured foe: Anything hostile. A little of everything, a master of none.

Sign nothing you have not read. But the seal is made so.
A rod, a rope, a jug, a lamp and a bottle. Mind the tolerances.
